quote: We propose MQUAKE (Multi-hop Question Answering for Knowledge Editing), a new benchmark for a more complete evaluation of knowledge-editing methods. Each example in MQUAKE consists of a multi-hop question (including {2, 3, 4}-hop questions) which corresponds to a chain of facts.
